Markets.title: Beyond Equity: Jiraaf’s Saurav Ghosh on how to customise your portfolio, and the importance of bonds
Markets.summary: Jiraaf founder Saurav Ghosh emphasizes that investment portfolios must be customized to individual timelines to ensure financial goals are met. He discusses risk management, profit margins, and the importance of allocating a portion of the portfolio to bonds.

Markets.title: Nykaa Q2 Results: PAT soars 207% YoY to Rs 101 crore, revenue up 28%; co to acquire 82% stake in Simply Nam
Markets.summary: Nykaa reported a 207% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 101 crore for Q2FY27, alongside a 28% rise in revenue to Rs 3,006 crore. The company also announced plans to acquire an 82% stake in Simply Nam to further strengthen its expansion.

Markets.title: Auto sales growth to cool post-festive season, says Monarch; bets on Minda Corp, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners
Markets.summary: Auto sales growth is expected to moderate in the second half of fiscal year 2027 following strong festive demand, while tractor sales are anticipated to remain weak. Brokerage Monarch Networth Capital recommends diversified auto component makers Minda Corporation, RK Forgings, and Sundram Fasteners, projecting potential upside of up to 44%.

Markets.title: European shares rise as banks, clean energy stocks rally; Novo Nordisk jumps
Markets.summary: European shares rose after Democrats won control of both chambers of the U.S. Congress, boosting investor sentiment. The market rally was led by banks, clean-energy stocks, and pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk, which raised its annual sales and profit forecasts.

Markets.title: Rupee gains 17 paise to settle at 94.58 against Us dollar
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee rose 17 paise to settle at 94.58 against the US dollar. This second consecutive session of appreciation was driven by falling crude oil prices, foreign investments, and strong domestic equity markets.

Markets.title: Bitcoin near $78,600, Ethereum at $2,300 as US midterm results put crypto regulation in focus
Markets.summary: Bitcoin traded near $78,000 and Ethereum held at $2,300 amid institutional outflows and cautious market sentiment. Investors monitored US midterm election results, potential regulatory changes, Federal Reserve rate expectations, and ETF flows for direction.

Geo-Political.title: South Carolina elects Democratic senator for first time in almost three decades
Geo-Political.summary: Annie Andrews is projected to defeat Darline Graham in South Carolina's Senate election. This marks the first time in nearly thirty years that the state has elected a Democratic senator.

Geo-Political.title: James Talarico becomes first Democrat to win Texas Senate seat since 1988
Geo-Political.summary: James Talarico won a Texas Senate seat, marking the first time a Democrat has won the position since 1988. Political experts described the broader Democratic victories in the state as historic.

Geo-Political.title: Florida Republicans fend off Democrats as state elects first black governor
Geo-Political.summary: Republican Byron Donalds was elected as Florida's first Black governor, defeating his Democratic opponents. Trump-backed Donalds successfully maintained Republican control of the state's highest office.

Geo-Political.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
Geo-Political.summary: Iranian chief negotiator Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf stated that American voters rejected war by defeating the Republican Party. Donald Trump similarly acknowledged that the ongoing conflict contributed to his party's electoral loss.

Geo-Political.title: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force
Geo-Political.summary: Delhi's air quality index reached 377 on Wednesday morning, placing it in the "very poor" category. This deterioration occurred as firework restrictions went into effect ahead of Diwali.

Geo-Political.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
Geo-Political.summary: South Africans are voting in local elections while expressing frustration to the BBC over poor public services. The ruling African National Congress (ANC) faces mounting pressure to reverse the nation's decline.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT for a specific software-building query without paying for ads. This discovery highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and simplify their workflow.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These tools automate repetitive tasks to improve workflow, increase productivity, and drive innovation.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article discusses various AI content generator tools available in 2022 to help users create effective, engaging, and relevant content efficiently. It notes that choosing the right tool can be difficult given the large number of options on the market.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money through its platform. The article also provides a list of top CJ affiliate programs and alternative options for users.

Data & Insights.title: India sees some trade relief, new risks after US midterm vote
Data & Insights.summary: The U.S. midterm election results have weakened Donald Trump's political standing. This gives India more breathing room to negotiate a trade deal without accepting unfavorable terms.

Data & Insights.title: Services sector growth hits a four-month peak in October, PMI survey shows
Data & Insights.summary: Driven by strong domestic demand, India's services sector growth reached a four-month high with the HSBC PMI rising to 55.8 in October. Although cost pressures dropped to a six-year low, export orders and hiring experienced a slowdown.

Data & Insights.title: Geographical branding revolutionized French champagne; are GI tags working for India, too?
Data & Insights.summary: India is increasingly assigning Geographical Indication (GI) tags to region-specific products to boost their branding. While some of these geographical origin initiatives have succeeded, many others still need to unlock their potential.

Data & Insights.title: US midterm election results impact on Indian economy: From trade deal to oil prices and stock markets, explained
Data & Insights.summary: Experts anticipate setbacks for Donald Trump's Republican party in the US midterm elections. This analysis examines how the election results could impact key areas of the Indian economy, including trade deals, oil prices, and stock markets.

Data & Insights.title: India plans stringent digital locks to secure banking data
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to update rules for protecting, storing, and transferring encryption keys to strengthen banking data security. The Bureau of Indian Standards will align these updated digital safeguards with the latest international norms.

Data & Insights.title: Why did Pakistan suffer $40 billion in economic losses after trade with India stopped? Which sectors are most affected?
Data & Insights.summary: Pakistan has suffered an estimated $40 billion in economic losses since suspending trade with India in 2019. The Pak-India Business Council states that this disruption has caused higher import costs, supply delays, and industrial damage, prompting a call to restore commercial ties.

India.title: Tamil Nadu Group 1 Services Vacancy List Out: Check Post-Wise Details
India.summary: The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission released the post-wise vacancy list for the Group 1 Services. According to official records, the preliminary examination for these positions was conducted on September 27, 2026.

India.title: Cabinet Approves Rs 4,371-Crore Scheme To Revamp Statistical System
India.summary: The Indian cabinet approved the Rs 4,371-crore VISTAR scheme to revamp the country's statistical system. Running for five years until 2030-31, the initiative focuses on statistical transformation, analytics, and research.

India.title: Sam Altman Says Indians Have "Incredible Builder Energy" When It Comes To AI
India.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that Indians possess exceptional "builder energy" regarding artificial intelligence. His comments highlight differing global perspectives on the rapid advancement of AI across various economies.

India.title: CBSE Board Exam 2027 Date Sheet Delay Leaves Lakhs Of Students Waiting
India.summary: Lakhs of students are currently waiting for the release of the CBSE Board Exam 2027 date sheet. Last year, the tentative schedule was issued on September 24 and the final schedule on October 30.

India.title: Dialling Wrong Number, Maybe You Should Protest: Chief Justice On Quota Plea
India.summary: The Supreme Court heard a petition requesting the mandatory rotation of constituencies reserved for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in state Assemblies. The Chief Justice dismissed the plea, suggesting that the petitioners should protest instead of approaching the court.

India.title: Cabinet Approves Rs 2,814-Crore Scheme For Critical Mineral Processing
India.summary: The Indian Cabinet has approved a Rs 2,814-crore scheme to support critical mineral processing. The initiative provides capital support capped at Rs 500 crore for lithium projects and Rs 900 crore for nickel projects.

General.title: Anthony Zurcher: Democrats push deep into Trump heartland on historic night
General.summary: Two Senate races previously considered battlegrounds resulted in decisive victories for Democrats. These wins occurred in political regions strongly associated with Donald Trump.

General.title: Trump takes aim at Republicans but says Democrats did a 'good job'
General.summary: Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that Republicans would have won in a landslide if his name had been on the ballot. He also criticized Republicans while praising Democrats for doing a good job.

General.title: How America voted in maps and charts
General.summary: This article presents maps and charts detailing the results of the United States midterm elections. It visualizes how different regions across America voted during these elections.

General.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan to become first Muslim senator in US history
General.summary: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan. With this victory, El-Sayed became the first Muslim senator in United States history.

General.title: Standout moments from a night of midterm election firsts
General.summary: Democrats achieved major victories and historic milestones during the midterm elections. President Trump congratulated the party on these wins.

General.title: 'Multi-cancer' blood tests coming to some GP surgeries in England
General.summary: GP surgeries in England are introducing new multi-cancer blood tests. The goal is to detect hard-to-diagnose abdominal cancers, such as liver, ovarian, and pancreatic cancer, much earlier.
